scenes.basis: 10:1 "one who doesn't enter by the door into the sheep fold" - the Good Shepherd discourse names no place; it follows the Jerusalem controversy of 9:8-41
10:23 "Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon's porch" - at the Feast of the Dedication (10:22)
10:40 "He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first" - Bethany beyond the Jordan (1:28)
